text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ouch...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I messed up, didn't I...
Did I twist my leg...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Checking the swollen area, it feels hotter than expected.
It might be best to proceed with caution.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Don't overthink things.
I can run. Just believe in that.
choice_data_list: Let's take it easy and rest for a bit.
I'll do my best to patch you up!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: "A while"...? Hey, how long is that supposed to be?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
We don't have time to be talking so leisurely.
Just hurry up and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told her we'd be in trouble if she developed bad habits
in her running form from trying to protect the injury.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Tch, fine, got it.
You got a point there, too."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: For now, I'll hold it in...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yeah, please.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment I went to treat the injury,
Narita Brian scowled.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hey, this is nothing... nggh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Tch, fine, got it.
That's the best call to make, right?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after agreeing to take a rest and leaving the infirmary,
Narita Brian still looked gloomy...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Alright, then I leave it to you.
As soon as first aid is complete, I wish to resume immediately.
choice_data_list: I won't let you do anything reckless.
I won't let you do anything reckless.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, unreasonable? Hardly.
You're a Trainer, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I know you're knowledgeable about taping and icing.
And that you treat things properly, too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, you're slacking off.
Take this seriously.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to proper treatment,
Narita Brian was able to overcome her injury.
